title: Bistable wavefronts in the Gurtin-MacCamy population model
summary: In this paper we prove the existence of monotone traveling wave solutions for an age-structured population model with a monotone and bistable nonlinearity. We formulate the problem in terms of a discrete-time recurrence $u_{n+1} = Q[u_n]$, with operator $Q$ encoding the role of the speed into its definition. For each speed, we prove the existence of a traveling wave by the general theory of monotone evolution systems, and from appropriate estimates on the speed, we deduce the existence of a traveling wave of the original problem.
